findings.detail: og:image and twitter:image in layout.tsx are hardcoded to https://shadow-tournaments.vercel.app/shadow-banner.png. If the deployment domain differs, social preview cards will serve a broken image. Fix by using metadataBase or NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL.

findings.summary: Mobile nav drawer uses exact pathname match instead of startsWith
findings.detail: Desktop nav correctly uses pathname.startsWith(link.href) but the mobile drawer uses pathname === link.href. Sub-pages under /docs/ will not highlight the Docs link on mobile.

findings.summary: Discord bot still uses Legendary Esports brand (out of web scope)
findings.detail: apps/discord-bot/src/ contains 12+ files with Legendary Esports in embed footers and /setup command descriptions. Out of scope for this diff but visible to end-users via Discord.
